shots.detail_en: In the emptied hall after close, CH tidies order slips under a single ceiling lamp as leather footsteps approach, magnified by the silence.
CH turns — XIONG has come down from the second floor himself for the first time, standing in the lamplight of the hall.
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH and XIONG face each other at the hall's center across the dark screen, ten steps apart.
shots.sub: 年轻人，买联华实业，买得很热闹。／您砸联华实业，砸得很安静。
shots.speaker: XIONG+CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG's prayer beads circle his wrist one loop after another, his smile benevolent.
shots.sub: 市场惩罚的是贪婪的人——我只是市场的一只手。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH's gaze does not waver, steady as the closing needle of a candlestick.
shots.sub: 盘口会说谎，成交量不会。您那只手——迟早会在量上露出来。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Panel-split crosscuts: CH and XIONG close in word by word, two market philosophies colliding head-on.
shots.sub: 我从来没有做错过任何事。／K 线没有错——错的，是画线的人。
shots.speaker: XIONG+CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG narrows his eyes, studying the tie knotted tight at CH's collar.
shots.sub: 十年前，也有个看盘很准的人——领带，也系得这么紧。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: FATHER's 1993 rain-night imagery: only a hand gripping a pocket-watch chain, a tie whipped straight by the wind — never the face.
Back to now: CH's knuckles whiten around his watch chain, the links pulled taut between his fingers.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG presses his palms together and lowers his lids, mourning like a true old friend.
shots.sub: 在雨里。九三年六月十七的雨里——愿他安息。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH shuts his eyes for one breath, then opens them, pressing the kill into the calm.
shots.sub: 熊先生。你今天下来，不是为了聊天气。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG circles CH slowly, half a round, appraising him like an auction lot.
shots.sub: 我给你留二楼一个位置。你父亲当年——就差这一步。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH looks down at his watch, the one-minute-slow second hand passing a single tick.
shots.sub: 我不上二楼。我爸看盘的地方，从来是一楼大厅。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH picks up his mop and starts mopping, straight past XIONG's polished shoes.
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: CH mops to one step short of XIONG's shoes and looks up at him.
shots.sub: 扫地。这是我的场子——您，是客人。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: XIONG laughs aloud, warmly, until his eyes crease into kindness.
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONG walks to the doorway, his silhouette pausing in the backlight.
shots.sub: 年轻人，风大的时候——替我把楼里的人，都看好。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Night rain rising; CH climbs alone to the rooftop where his father fell ten years ago, the railing unchanged in a decade.
CH's palm closes white-knuckled over the pocket watch, motionless.
CH stands at the roof's edge framed exactly like his father ten years ago — but his back to the drop, pressing the watch to his chest, saying nothing.

shots.card: 有些仗，是替十年前的人打的。
